statement: NVIDIA reiterated Q3 gross margin guidance of 74% plus or minus 50 basis points and cited a Q4 gross-margin floor of 71-72%, a step down attributed to memory costs.
why: A guided margin path from 74% down to a 71-72% floor shows rising input costs being absorbed rather than fully passed through.

impact.mechanism: Higher memory prices compress accelerator gross margin, which is the cleanest read on pricing power versus input cost.

evidence.source: BigGo Finance (citing NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
evidence.excerpt: Q3 gross margin guidance reiterated as 74% plus/minus 50 basis points

confidence.basis: Secondary summary of call guidance; the 74% figure matches the primary press release but the 71-72% Q4 floor is only in this retelling.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 75.0 -> 74.0 (tol 1%); sources: BigGo Finance (citing NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call), NVIDIA Newsroom
